newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's Banque du Sud to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's Banque du Sud to raise capital.

text.p: Tunisia's Banque du Sud on Monday said it will raise its capital from 50 million dinars to 75 million dinars.
It said that it will offer for sale 4.4 million new shares worth 22 million dinars at seven dinars each, including a nominal five dinars and an issuing premium of two dinars.

The remaining three million dinars represent an incorporation of reserves with the issuing of 600,000 new shares to be distributed free of charges to the current shareholders at the rate of three new for 50 old shares.

Current shareholders have the priority for buying the 4.4 million new shares from October 1 to November 15, 1996, after what the remainder will be offered for sale to the public starting of November 25.
BS provisional net profits for the first half of 1996 amounted to 4.233 million dinars, up from 4.047 million dinars during the same period last year.
Net profit in 1995 was 9.661 million dinars, up from 9.508 million dinars in 1994.
The state-controlled bank has among its shareholders Italian bank Monte Dei Paschi Di Siena.
BS in 1995 raised its capital to 50 million dinars from 30 million dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
